merchant/30436-1.htm.text: Trader Sarien: Basically, there are eight main ingredients used in the research of magic. The eight ingredients are crimson mushrooms, Dragon's Tooth, green wild grapes, Mandragora Roots, monster eye meat, willow roots, bone powder and jade fragments. Q00328_SenseForBusiness/30436-05.html.text: Trader Sarien: Come, partner. I am glad you have returned safely from the rugged land. First, relax and catch your breath. As your sack is bulging, you must have gathered quite a few products. Let us take a look at the outcome of the hunt! As promised, I will pay you according to how many items you…

Q00328_SenseForBusiness/30436-04.html.text: Trader Sarien: Ho, why are your hands empty, partner? Were you not supposed to find me monster eye carcasses and lenses , and the gizzards of the basilisk ? You aren't going to quit by any chance, are you?

Q00328_SenseForBusiness/30436-03.htm.text: Trader Sarien: Good. Spit on the ground and shake on it. Now we have a contract with the goddess of earth, Maphr, as our witness. Now listen to what I have to say. Do you remember the eight basic ingredients used for magic research I told you about earlier? We can find some of them in this area. If…

Q00328_SenseForBusiness/30436-06.html.text: Trader Sarien: I am sorry to hear that. And there I was, thinking I had met a partner whom I could work with for a long time. However, I have no choice but to look for another partner... Well, I wish you happiness in your future.

Q00328_SenseForBusiness/30436-07.html.text: Trader Sarien: Then please continue your efforts. I must look for a coach that will deliver the products to Oren's Ivory Tower. I must earn more money to achieve the large business I have planned in my head.
